summary: Aggregate today's Claude Code activity across all projects on this machine into a per-project digest. LLM-free.

flags.--help: Print this JSON help schema and exit.
flags.--cwd: Override the operator's cwd reference. Informational only; does not affect which sessions are scanned.
flags.--format: Output mode. "json" (default) emits machine-readable JSON; "context" emits the markdown additionalContext the UserPromptSubmit hook would inject.

notes: Worktrees under `.codex/worktrees/<task>` and `.claude/worktrees/<task>` are merged back to the host repo.
TeamAgent itself never calls an LLM here — the additionalContext form is meant to be consumed by the operator's own Claude Code window.

output.windowStartMs: epoch ms of today's local midnight
output.windowEndMs: epoch ms when the scan ran
output.worktreeMergedCount: how many groups contained at least one worktree session
output.skippedSessionCount: how many jsonl files failed to parse
output.archivedPath: path to the written archive markdown when --archive is set
